summary: This dataset is based on an existing electronic health records (EHR) database, the Duke Glaucoma Registry, and aims to develop an automated pre-screening framework for psychosocial distress (anxiety, depression) in glaucoma patients. The framework will use predictive modeling to identify high-risk patients, allowing for targeted administration of a distress survey and limiting assessment to those who need it. The study will also explore the acceptability of distress screening in a glaucoma clinic and refine a behavioral intervention to improve coping skills for distress in patients with glaucoma.
